description: This file contains integration tests for batch loan operations in the Fineract project, including loan creation, approval, disbursement, and rescheduling via batch API calls. It extends base loan test functionalities and verifies behaviors under various conditions such as COB and hard lock scenarios.

classes.name: BatchLoanIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing batch loan operations such as rescheduling and handling of special loan states (COB, hard lock) in the Fineract system.

methods.name: test_InlineLoanCOB_ShouldExecute_WhenLoanIsBehind_And_RescheduleIsRequestedViaBatchApi
methods.description: Tests the batch rescheduling of a loan that is behind schedule with COB (close of business) processing.

methods.name: test_InlineLoanCOB_ShouldExecute_WhenLoanIsHardLocked_And_RescheduleIsRequestedViaBatchApi
methods.description: Tests the batch rescheduling of a hard-locked loan and expects a conflict response (409).
